reason: B provides the more specific, falsifiable intervention and a physically plausible dense HfO2 barrier, with defined temperature, exposure time, baseline, and interfacial measurements; it also extends prior oxidation findings to molten-aluminum corrosion. A is materially underspecified, offers no direct evidence that 2–5 wt% Si will form a stable protective phase in a boride exposed to molten Al, and cites evidence from largely irrelevant diffusion and molten-salt systems.
